set.description: 认识三角形的边、角、顶点，按边（不等边、等腰、等边）和按角（锐角、直角、钝角）对三角形分类。
set.name: Concept and Classification of Triangles

criteria: 能求常见完全平方数的平方根
set.description: 会用平方运算求完全平方数的平方根，了解 √(a²)=|a|，并能用计算器求近似值。
set.name: Finding Square Roots
set.nameZh: 开平方与平方根的求法

set.reason: An altitude is drawn from a triangle vertex to the opposite side or its extension, so those triangle elements are needed.
set.scope: vertex and opposite side for altitudes

set.reason: The theorem's third-side computation requires taking a nonnegative square root of a sum or difference of squares.
set.scope: computing the third side from two sides

set.reason: The theorem relates the sides of a right triangle; acute-angle complementarity is unnecessary. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Right-triangle, hypotenuse and leg meanings in the Pythagorean assertion

set.reason: Triangles supply familiar side/vertex/angle language, while a polygon and its diagonals can be defined directly from a closed segmented boundary. Triangle classification is not required by diagonal counting.
set.scope: generalizing sides, vertices and angles to polygons

set.reason: Triangle classification helps recognize where an altitude may lie. The area relation and a supplied base/height can be used across all triangle types without first sorting them as acute, right or obtuse.
set.scope: locating heights in right and obtuse triangles

set.reason: The target explicitly states that the triangle has half the area of an equal-base equal-height parallelogram. Parallelogram-area meaning is needed for that specified comparison.
set.scope: triangle as half a parallelogram

criteria: 能说出三角形面积是等底等高平行四边形的一半
set.description: 会用底乘高除以 2 计算三角形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Triangle

criteria: 能说出多边形的相关概念
set.description: 认识多边形的边、顶点、内角、外角、对角线及正多边形，知道 n 边形从一个顶点出发可引 n-3 条对角线。
set.name: Polygons and Their Diagonals

set.description: 直角三角形两直角边的平方和等于斜边的平方：a²+b²=c²。
set.name: Pythagorean theorem

criteria: Explain that the consistently chosen exterior angles of a convex polygon sum to 360 degrees.
Find the number of sides of a regular convex polygon by dividing 360 degrees by one exterior angle.
set.description: For a convex polygon, take one exterior angle at every vertex using a consistent turn direction. These exterior angles sum to 360 degrees.
set.name: Sum of the Exterior Angles of a Polygon

criteria: 能用判定证明线段相等
set.description: 有两个角相等的三角形是等腰三角形（等角对等边）。
set.name: Criteria for Isosceles Triangles

criteria: 能画出锐角、直角、钝角三角形的高
知道三条高所在直线交于一点
set.description: 从三角形的一个顶点向对边（或其延长线）作垂线，顶点与垂足间的线段叫高，三角形有三条高。
set.name: Altitudes of a Triangle

set.description: 综合运用二次根式的四则运算与乘法公式。
set.name: Mixed operations with square root expressions

set.description: 会用底乘高计算平行四边形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Parallelogram

criteria: 能说出等边三角形三条边都相等
set.description: 会按角把三角形分成锐角、直角、钝角三角形，按边认出等腰三角形和等边三角形。
set.name: Classifying triangles
